user.title: Water Flow Scheduler
user.description: Adds the irrigation scheduler; programs are configured with its services.

invalid_time.message: Times must use the HH:MM 24-hour format.

invalid_duration.message: duration must be a whole number of minutes between 1 and {max}.

invalid_liters.message: liters must be a finite number greater than zero.

invalid_frequency.message: frequency_days must be a whole number between 1 and {max}.

invalid_start_date.message: start_date must use the YYYY-MM-DD format.

frequency_needs_anchor.message: A frequency above one day needs a start_date anchor.

invalid_auto_entity.message: auto_entity must be an input_boolean entity.

entity_validation_failed.message: The entity does not accept this program: {message}

no_program.message: No schedule exists for this switch entity.

too_many_slots.message: A program may contain at most {max} slots.

empty_enabled_program.message: An enabled program needs at least one window.

invalid_slot_schema.message: Each window needs id, days, start, duration, and optionally liters.

invalid_slot_id.message: Window id must start alphanumeric and use letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

invalid_days.message: days must be a non-empty list of ISO weekdays 1..7.

entity_unavailable.message: The switch entity is unavailable; the pump command is pending.

cannot_release_control.message: Scheduler control could not be released because the switch is unavailable.
